photoc - Command-line tools for photographers.

Usage: photoc [global options] <command> [args]
       photoc <command> --help

Commands:
  check        Audit JPEG structural readability
  compress     Re-encode JPEGs by quality or target size
  exif         Inspect JPEG metadata
  duplicates   Find exact duplicate files
  stats        Summarize JPEG collections
  rename       Preview or apply JPEG renames
  sort         Preview or apply JPEG sorting
  focus        Compare JPEG sharpness scores
  scrub        Remove EXIF GPS metadata from JPEGs

Global options:
  -h, --help       Show global or command help
  -V, --version    Show the version
  -v, --verbose    Add diagnostics on stderr
  -q, --quiet      Suppress status text and non-critical warnings
      --json       Request JSON output where supported

Exif and stats inspect JPEG files; duplicates compares file bytes.
Rename and sort preview by default; compress and scrub write copies.
Focus scores JPEG sharpness as a review aid, not a blur verdict.
Run 'photoc <command> --help' for usage and examples.
